purpose: Define explicit Topic classification for namespace roots and owner contracts so recursive namespace reading also resolves semantic concern/grouping without treating Topic membership as ownership.

topics.name: Namespace Topic Binding
topics.purpose: Define explicit Topic classification for namespace roots and owner contracts so recursive namespace reading also resolves semantic concern/grouping without treating Topic membership as ownership.

semantics.rule: Every reserved root/owner contract belongs to one or more Topics or is explicitly outsider.
semantics.multi_topic_rule: A namespace owner may belong to multiple Topics.
semantics.separation_rule: Topic membership does not select or transfer namespace ownership.
semantics.recursive_rule: Root introspection may expose direct, inherited and composed Topic context.
semantics.locality_rule: Topic declarations remain with the semantic owner/root contract for recursive readability.
semantics.reader_rule: A generic reader can resolve root -> owner -> Topic graph without filesystem heuristics.

invariants.rule: Every active reserved runtime root has exactly one explicit owner contract and remains distinguishable from runtime availability, Topic grouping and physical implementation location.

hard_gates.condition: namespace owner has neither Topic nor outsider classification
Topic membership used to infer namespace owner
Topic lookup requires undocumented filesystem heuristic

references.purpose: Namespace owners use the common Topic model.
Owner identity remains independent from Topic classification.

prose.summary: Define explicit Topic classification for namespace roots and owner contracts so recursive namespace reading also resolves semantic concern/grouping without treating Topic membership as ownership.
